title: 前開きドラム式洗濯機
description: 共同ランドリーや施設の洗濯室向けの洗濯機外観。前板の実開口、奥行きのある空のドラム、内側リフター、ゴム蛇腹、固定した開扉・不透明な窓表現、洗剤引出し、無表示操作部、背面接続口と収納状態のホース、底板と調整足を造形。洗浄・回転・通水・電装・扉動作は実装していません。性能、電気・水回りの安全性や製品適合性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.608 × 0.848 × 1.168 m、22,096三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A washing-machine appearance prop for shared laundries and facility washrooms. It has a genuine front-panel aperture, deep empty drum and interior lifters, rubber bellows, fixed swung-open door with an opaque window representation, detergent drawer, inactive controls, rear connection collars and parked hoses, underside plate and leveling feet. Washing, rotation, plumbing, electrical operation and door motion are not implemented. Performance, electrical/plumbing safety and product compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.608 × 0.848 × 1.168 m; 22,096 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
